title: Rendu
desc: Sakthi moves to the city in search of a job. However, he lands in trouble when a CBI officer mistakes him for a serial killer who is his doppelgänger.

title: Jallikattu Kaalai
desc: Gopalkrishnan, an ordinary mill worker, falls in love with the mill owner's daughter. However, a vicious landlord causes a stir in their lives.

title: Chidambarathil Oru Appasamy
desc: A school teacher leads a carefree life without any goal. However, a pilgrimage to Sabarimala transforms his life and the lives of his loved ones forever.

title: Oru Melliya Kodu
desc: A deceased woman's husband becomes a suspect after her body goes missing from the morgue. The disappearance exposes a web of lies and deceit when things unravel.

title: Villadhi Villain
desc: Meenatchi Sundara Sasthiriyaar, an eminent lawyer, is against the relationship of his daughter with Edison. When Edison is charged for the murder of a minister, he seeks Meenatchi's help.
